why: The published calibration (inferex-centuaros) is a TWO-enemy fight, and the party's multi-target actions all collapse to one target against a solo boss. Reading a solo verdict through a multi-enemy bias understates the party badly. This is the solo anchor.

live.note: Asura carries 900 HP, so the party cleared ~900 HP in ~4 rounds ⇒ live effective DPR ≈ 225.

bias.direction: PESSIMISTIC — Mindscape understates party output against a SOLO boss by roughly 2.25x, well beyond the ~1.3x implied by the two-enemy calibration.
bias.confidence: LOW, and now also STALE — the 2.25 ratio divides live 225 by a mindscape baselineDpr of 100.1 that was measured against an Asura missing two of its passives. The live half is still the best anchor available; re-derive the ratio the next time any solo boss is live-tested, and do not treat 2.25 as more than an order-of-magnitude correction.
knownCauses: FIXED 2026-09-08: Blanche now fights. Twin Shields (an exposedVirtualAttack AE) is modelled and SL_<SKILL> resolves from the actor items, so she is no longer absent. This is why the ratio moved 2.4 -> 2.25.
Zarg has no modelled damage skills and falls back to his bow weapon action alone.
Multi-target actions (Glacies, Tafallera) collapse to one target and lose most of their value.
Summons, Zero Power, Fabula Point invokes and the party reaction layer are all unmodelled — and a long solo fight gives every one of them more time to matter than a 2-round group fight does.

howToRead: For a SOLO boss, multiply Mindscape BaselineDPR by ~2.25 before deriving an HP budget. Round count and party-HP figures stay pessimistic and should not be read literally: Mindscape calls Asura a 98% defeat where live was a victory at 21%.

modelHistory.what: Asura stopped acting entirely and was repaired; two of its passives are now modelled.
modelHistory.detail: Between this file's capture and 2026-09-09, stance-cycle inference (713f0742) made every Asura action illegal -- it dealt ZERO damage and the report called the fight TRIVIAL at 100% party HP. Fixed in stances.js: requires-without-grants is a lockout, not a cycle. The repaired model reproduced this file's figures (defeat 0.98, median 5 rounds), which is what confirmed the fix rather than a coincidence. Elemental Aspect (+10 outgoing once enchanted) and Four-Armed Fury (+20 while Asura is in Crisis) are now registered in lib/reactions.js. They were never modelled before, so every earlier Asura number in this file -- baselineDpr 100.1 included -- was measured against a weaker Asura than the one on the sheet.
stillUnmodelled: Ascension: +8 per charge, up to +32 on every slash. Needs multi-status state -- live Asura
spends four activations on four different Sword Enchants to bank four charges, and
stances.js holds a single-valued stance, so the model arms once and can never reach 4.
Quad-Elemental Slash: 4 x 45 flat, party-wide, every third round; gated on those 4 charges.
EnemyDPR 154.0 is therefore still a FLOOR.
